race.description: Father's Day Feast At Club Paceway Sept 6 Book Now Pace
race.comment: TIGERLICIOUS (6) has been competitive of late and kept the ball rolling last time when 2.75 metres from the winner in fourth over 1720m at this track. Meets a comparable field and she is a strong winning hope. FINAL PROMISE (2) is in good form at present. Finished third at his latest appearance over 1720m at this track, beaten 2 metres. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Good enough to win a race of this calibre. JETASI NZ (3) finished fourth two runs ago then suffered interference and broke when a distant last over 1609m at Menangle at the latest appearance. Likely to get all the favours this time from this nice draw. Finds a nice race and can make up for that last start mishap. GREY CADILLAC (10) showed pleasing improvement last time out when third over 2125m at this track.
